evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template; build context is environment/, it installs only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 9-12) and copies only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15). No RewardKit, judge CLI (claude-code/codex), Playwright MCP, tests/ or criteria are shipped to the agent. Agent-visible text: grep of environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md, integration.md and instruction.md for criteri|rubric|judge|reward|score|grad returned no matches; none of the 55 criterion ids from tests/*/*/judge.toml appear anywhere under environment/, instruction.md or solution/. Verifier isolation: task.toml:26-28 sets [verifier] environment_mode = "separate" with the frozen [verifier.env] block (lines 30-35; key via ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template only). tests/Dockerfile (template-identical) installs RewardKit/claude-code/playwright only in the verifier image and does `chmod -R go-rwx /tests` (line 44). tests/test.sh (template-identical) sets umask 077 (line 3), chmod 700 on LOG_DIR (line 11), re-applies go-rwx to /tests (line 12), writes zero reward first with an EXIT trap (lines 60-61), rejects symlinks escaping /app/node_modules (lines 72-83), and runs the submission as uid/gid 65534 under env -i (lines 104-111, restart helper 160-167), so submitted code cannot read criteria in /tests or write reward.txt/reward.json/app.pid in /logs/verifier. Reward is computed only by tests/tools/score.py (template-identical) from RewardKit outputs (lines 203-227). Weak-app probe (reasoned): a server.js that tries to read /tests/scored/functional/judge.toml or write /logs/verifier/reward.txt fails with EACCES as uid 65534 against root-owned 0700 paths; a symlink in /app to /tests causes test.sh to exit with the zero reward. Conforming alternative: no legitimate app needs these paths, so isolation cannot wrongly penalize one. UI-text prompt injection toward the judge is the domain of row 45; every prompt.md opens with the untrusted-submission clause. Limitation: this is a static source review; I did not build or inspect the images (no Docker per assignment). Because all relevant files are template-identical and the claim is structural, no runtime measurement is required for this row.
